questions.question: A recipe requires a 2:3 ratio of sugar to flour. If you use 8 cups of sugar, how many cups of flour do you need?
questions.explanation: Ratio 2:3 means 2 parts sugar to 3 parts flour. If 2 parts = 8 cups, then 1 part = 4 cups. 3 parts = 3 × 4 = 12 cups.
questions.fastStrategy: Use ratio to scale: if a:b ratio and first = x, then second = x × (b/a).

questions.question: If 5 workers can complete a job in 12 days, how many days will it take 8 workers to complete the same job?
questions.explanation: Work is inversely proportional to workers. 5 workers × 12 days = 8 workers × x days. 60 = 8x. x = 7.5 days.
questions.fastStrategy: Inverse proportion: x₁ × y₁ = x₂ × y₂.
